namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs the public pages into. It must be the frontend's PUBLIC_NAMESPACE (the frontend chart's `publicNamespace`, krateo-public by default) — the short address /public/<slug> opens flexes/page-<slug> in that namespace and nowhere else, and the pages' own links (Request access again) are short addresses. The only grant in it is the public identity's (user krateo:public, snowplow#1334), on exactly the objects these pages read. It holds no data, so it is not kept on uninstall. No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, and crdgen materializes them into every CR; the chart default lives in values.yaml.
namespace.title: namespace

requestAccess.description: The request form's per-installation legal copy — who processes the requester's details, under which privacy policy, and what the optional newsletter is. These name the OPERATOR of the installation, so they are values rather than chart text; the defaults (values.yaml) are the approved copy for Krateo's own installation.

newsletterConsent.description: The label of the OPTIONAL newsletter checkbox.
newsletterConsent.title: newsletterConsent

privacyPolicy.description: The privacy policy linked from the processing-consent label.

text.description: The phrase of `processingConsent` that becomes the link (its first occurrence). When the label does not contain it, the link follows the label.
text.title: text

url.description: The privacy policy's address, an http(s) URL. Opened in a new tab.
url.title: url

privacyPolicy.title: privacyPolicy

processingConsent.description: The label of the REQUIRED processing-consent checkbox. Name the data controller and what the details are used for. When it contains `privacyPolicy.text`, that phrase becomes the link.
processingConsent.title: processingConsent
